🇩🇪 A1 GERMAN VOCABULARY: Haushalt (Household)

die Waschmaschine = washing machine
der Staubsauger = vacuum cleaner
der Besen = broom
der Eimer = bucket
das Fenster = window
der Boden = floor

💡 Tip: Learn der/die/das with every noun.
